claims.text: This is a repeat no-show dispute between the same rider and the same driver inside the 90-day window: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2, and the rider's own claim text confirms it is 'another dispute with the same driver'. Under POL-NS-09(c) a pattern of 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver is a mandatory escalation trigger, and escalation under that clause is terminal — the Judge issues no monetary ruling and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

The contested SGD 4.00 has not been taken: fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.00 with charged_at null and no waiting-time or platform fee attached. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalated case is held rather than collected or refunded, so escalation on the repeat-dispute trigger in POL-NS-09(c) is the only disposition on this record that stops the disputed cancellation fee being collected from the rider before a human has reviewed a pair who have now disputed no-shows twice in 90 days.

Nothing on the rider's own profile supports an adverse imputation against this rider: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the rider-side abuse limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met. rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags (1) is a LIFETIME counter, and POL-GEN-01 fixes the trailing-window field no_show_disputes_30d as the one POL-NS-09(d) reads and forbids substituting the lifetime counter for it. The escalation therefore stands on the pair's repeat-dispute history between this rider and this driver under POL-NS-09(c), not on any imputation about this rider.

I disclose at the outset that EV-ADVIS-09110-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no traffic advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. Its absence is itself citable on the rider's side: because no advisory exists, the driver cannot invoke POL-NS-06(i) to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, and POL-NS-06 says in terms that a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable and that asserting the limb against a missing artifact triggers escalation rather than exonerating anyone.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the trip record: there is a driver arrival event at 2026-09-10T06:50:20+08:00, and the trip terminates as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. The anchor clause's first condition holds.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied: the driver's trace opens at 06:50:00 and every one of its 34 fixes sits a flat 24.01 m from the pickup pin at Blk 612 Bedok Reservoir Rd (VEN-BEDOK-612). That is inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup under POL-NS-02, and the position is already in-geofence 20 seconds before the recorded arrival event, so the driver was at the pin at or before the arrival timestamp as limb (b) requires.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the clock the clause actually prescribes. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:50:00, not from the arrival tap, and the trace shows one continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds over 34 fixes, ending at 06:55:30. That is 30 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for this STANDARD zone.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: no boarding event is recorded anywhere on the trip, the driver terminated at 06:55:30 — after the 300-second dwell expired at 06:55:00 — and the termination code is RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four limbs of the anchor clause hold, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable and none of POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

The rider was not at the pickup. The rider track's 16 fixes all stand about 519 m from the pin, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so no admissible rider fix places the rider's device anywhere near the lobby the driver was directed to. The rider's own 'Coming down now.' message is not corroborated by any position on the ground.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Even assuming 'Coming down now.' at 06:51:40 is a coordinating message under limb (a), the driver answered 'Okay, waiting.' at 06:52:00 — 20 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window — and had already posted 'At Block 612 lobby pickup.' at 06:50:35, so limb (b) fails on its own terms. Limb (c) fails independently, as the rider track carries no qualifying in-radius fix.

POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the 06:50:20 arrival marker the driver was stationary — the trace's only distinct speed is 0.0 km/h across all 34 fixes — and 24.01 m from the pin. He was therefore neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above, so there is no false arrival marker and no recomputation of the waiting clock.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged at all. That clause governs only a driver found stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin — the wrong-face-of-the-building case. This driver's fixes are 24.01 m from the pin, inside the 50 m radius, so no wrong-entrance analysis and no pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. The effective in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a surplus of 30 seconds, with the shortfall field reading negative — so the waiting-period shortfall condition is simply absent and no full refund follows from it. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09110-01, weight 0.0) never becomes relevant, because no accumulation of separate intervals is needed when a single run already meets the minimum.

The amount charged reconciles exactly and carries no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), which is precisely what the resolution rule produces for this trip. There is no fare defect to discount the charge on.

Nothing on this record is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: the arrival event at 06:50:20 falls on the trace's 10-second cadence with no skew, the trace has zero gaps and 34 fixes across the waiting window against a 6-fix floor, the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count with no missing msg_id and no five-minute gap across the arrival marker, and the fare reconciles. The single MISSING artifact is the traffic advisory, which carries weight 0.0, can carry no fact, and is relied on by no claim on either side.

The driver should be paid, not merely spared a refund. POL-NS-07 fixes his compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not withhold it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the check requires, and the same figure over 120 completed trips in 30 days is a rate of 0.0083, far below the 0.08 threshold. The further condition that both limbs must trip for withholding is therefore not met, and the fee disposition is NO_ACTION while the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not the trailing-30-day field this check reads.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case is escalated to a human reviewer, and no money moves while that review is pending. The disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is held — it will be neither collected from the rider nor refunded to the rider until the review is complete.

On the merits the driver has made out his case, and the rider's challenge to the fee fails. The trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 06:50:20 and a termination by the driver at 06:55:30 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, satisfying POL-NS-01(a) and (d). The GPS trace places the driver 24.01 m from the pin at Blk 612 Bedok Reservoir Rd from 06:50:00 — inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and in position 20 seconds before the marker — so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival (the driver was stationary, 0.0 km/h, 24 m from the pin). Measuring dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, as POL-NS-01(c) requires and not from the arrival tap, the driver held one continuous 330-second run to 06:55:30, 30 seconds beyond the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall and no full refund follows. The fare reconciles exactly: SGD 4.00 is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. On that basis the driver would be paid SGD 3.20 (80 percent of SGD 4.00) under POL-NS-07, and the anti-farming check does not withhold it (1 no-show termination in 30 days, a rate of about 0.008 against 120 completed trips).

That payout cannot issue automatically, because POL-NS-09(c) makes escalation mandatory where the profiles show 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d both read 2, and the rider's own filing describes 'another dispute with the same driver.' Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal: it replaces the monetary ruling, so the driver's compensation is not paid by the automated pipeline and the fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The escalation rests only on this repeat-dispute limb — rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the rider-side abuse limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met.

The rider's other arguments do not change the outcome. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: even taking 'Coming down now.' (06:51:40) as a coordinating message, the driver answered 'Okay, waiting.' 20 seconds later (06:52:00), inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) fails, and independently every rider fix sits about 519 m from the pin with no qualifying in-radius fix, so limb (c) fails too. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09110-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on by this ruling: a single continuous 330-second run already meets the minimum, so no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals was needed.

Open question for the reviewer: whether the repeated no-show disputes between this rider and this driver reflect genuine repeated rider no-shows or abuse on either side, and how the held SGD 4.00 should finally be disposed of. No clause directs a referral in this case.

To both parties: the tribunal cannot decide this one itself, so it goes to a human reviewer. Here is why, and where things stand.

The disputed amount is the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-09110. It has not been collected yet (the fare breakdown shows payment pending), so it is now placed on hold: it will not be taken from the rider and will not be refunded while the review is pending.

On the driving itself, the driver's account largely checks out. The trip record shows a driver arrival event at 06:50:20 and a cancellation by the driver at 06:55:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace places the driver about 24 m from the pin — well inside the 50 m Standard arrival radius — already at 06:50:00, and shows him stationary in a single continuous 330-second run, 30 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold on this record, and but for the point below the fee would have been chargeable and the driver would have been due SGD 3.20 under POL-NS-07 (its anti-farming check does not trip: 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, a rate of about 0.008, both limbs well under the thresholds).

The rider's contrary arguments do not change that. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: even taking 'Coming down now.' at 06:51:40 as a coordinating message, the driver replied 'Okay, waiting.' 20 seconds later — inside the 120-second window — and the rider's own device never came within the 100 m rider-presence radius at any qualifying fix (nearest reading about 519 m, zero qualifying fixes). POL-NS-05 is not triggered (the driver was stationary and about 24 m away at the arrival marker, neither over 300 m nor travelling at 15 km/h), so there is no false-arrival marker. POL-NS-03 is not engaged (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not in the wrong-entrance band, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises). POL-NS-06 yields no shortfall (330 seconds against a 300-second minimum). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09110-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) cannot support anything on either side and is not needed, because no accumulation of separate intervals was required.

What stops the tribunal ruling is the history between this pair. Both profiles record 2 disputes with the other party in the trailing 90 days, and the rider's own filing confirms this is 'another dispute with the same driver.' Under POL-NS-09(c), two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days is a mandatory escalation trigger, and escalation under that clause is terminal: it replaces any monetary outcome. That is why the driver's otherwise sound POL-NS-07 compensation claim is not paid now — it is accepted on its merits but displaced by the escalation. The rider's profile does not show rider-side abuse (no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only and is not the field the abuse limb reads), so the escalation rests solely on the repeat-dispute pattern between the two of you, not on any imputation against either party.

The open question the reviewer must settle: whether the repeat no-show pattern between this rider and this driver is genuine, and, if so, how the SGD 4.00 fee should finally be settled as between charge, refund and driver compensation.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this case is escalated to a human reviewer, so no money moves in this ruling. The disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is placed on hold — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — until a person decides it.

On the driving facts, the driver did everything this category asks, and we accept those submissions. The trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 06:50:20 and a termination by the driver at 06:55:30 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event anywhere on the trip (POL-NS-01(a) and (d)). The GPS trace places the driver's 34 fixes at a flat 24.01 m from the Blk 612 Bedok Reservoir Rd pin — inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — and already in-geofence 20 seconds before the 'arrived' tap (POL-NS-01(b)). The dwell, measured the way the clause actually prescribes, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 06:50:00 and not from the arrival tap, is 330 seconds against a 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 30-second surplus (POL-NS-01(c)). None of the displacing clauses applies: POL-NS-02 is satisfied; POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver was 24 m from the pin and well inside the arrival radius, not at the wrong face of the building; POL-NS-05 does not bite, because at the arrival marker the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) and 24 m away, so there is no false marker and no recomputation; POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because the driver replied 'Okay, waiting.' 20 seconds after the rider's 'Coming down now.', well inside the 120-second window, and independently the rider track carries no qualifying in-radius fix (all 16 rider fixes sit about 519 m away against a 100 m radius); and POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall. On that basis the driver's POL-NS-07 entitlement would be 80 percent of SGD 4.00, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not withhold it — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4 required) and 1 over 120 completed trips is a rate of 0.008 (below the 0.08 required), so both limbs fail to trip.

Why the case nevertheless does not end in a payment: POL-NS-09(c) is a mandatory escalation trigger and it fires. The rider profile and the driver profile each record disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 2 — two or more no-show disputes between this same rider and this same driver in the trailing 90 days — and the rider's own filing describes 'another dispute with the same driver'. That is precisely the repeat pattern between one rider and one driver that a single-case view cannot fairly assess, and escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal: it replaces any monetary ruling, both money fields are null, and the fee is held rather than collected or refunded. The rider's submission on this trigger is accepted, as is the related point that payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so a hold is the correct disposition.

On the rider's remaining points: nothing on the rider's profile builds an adverse case against them — no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so the rider-side abuse limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met, and prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context-only and that no clause reads. That submission is accepted. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09110-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) does make POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable and would trigger POL-NS-09 if it were asserted against, but nothing turns on it here: a single continuous 330-second run already meets the minimum, so no accommodation across separate intervals was ever needed, and the missing artifact carries no fact.

Two driver submissions were removed at the citation stage and are not reinstated: the claim that POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing, and the claim that nothing on the record is impaired for policy purposes. Both cited the weight-0.0 traffic advisory without naming its issue code, which POL-GEN-02(1) requires an advocate to disclose.

Confidence rests on the two profile artifacts that carry the escalation fact, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.9.

The specific open question the human reviewer must settle, and the instruction carried in this escalation packet: determine whether the two prior no-show disputes between this rider and this driver in the trailing 90 days reflect genuine unresolved no-shows (in which case the SGD 4.00 fee stands and the driver's SGD 3.20 compensation under POL-NS-07 is payable) or abuse or collusion by either party in the repeated-charge pattern, and dispose of the held fee accordingly. No clause in this policy directs any other referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty.
